ashwin: thanks, I'll kick a rerun for that job now. pinging @mike for logs if you have a quick look?

sam: can you paste the failing assertion/log? quick grep helps.

```
[ RUN      ] TimerWakeupTest.overlap_with_retry_window
test_timer.cpp:142: Failure
Expected: next_wakeup <= wake_deadline
  Actual: 3276 vs 3200
```
ashwin: looks like next_wakeup drifting forward. suspect timer coalescing after the kernel clamped short sleeps when system is busy.
